title: Multi-source procurement evidence to a supplier-performance report
purpose: Evaluate whether the GAIK Solution Configuration Wizard captures a fixed multi-source reporting scenario, selects and configures the report-synthesis module, generates a valid package, and produces an executable grounded-report PoC.

protocol.output_directory_policy: Use the run-specific directory as wizard workspace, expose only wizard_input, and write output to generated_package.
protocol.wizard_input_policy: Provide only run-specific wizard_input. Do not expose scenario_oracle.json, expected_report_results.json, scoring files, or comparison workbook.
protocol.confirmation_policy: At every routine confirmation before original PoC execution, answer Yes and proceed without changes.
protocol.unexpected_question_answer: Not specified for this evaluation. If a value is required, record it as an explicit assumption for user confirmation.
protocol.po_c_policy: Execute original wizard-generated PoC without source edits. Supplying fixed fixtures and credentials is allowed. EQ4 remains permanently based on attempt 0.

recovery_policy.trigger: The original PoC does not execute successfully.
recovery_policy.feedback_scope: Return recorded execution evidence to the wizard without corrective code or new requirements.
recovery_policy.stopping_rule: Stop after first successful execution or third unsuccessful refinement.

expected_component.name: MultiSourceReportGenerator
expected_component.selection_reason: The scenario requires an end-to-end evidence-grounded report from mixed source types with section-level review and traceability.

EQ1.oracle_value: Procurement analysts prepare quarterly supplier-performance reports for procurement management.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: Procurement analyst is the principal report-preparation user.

EQ1.oracle_value: An analyst manually combines KPI spreadsheets, quality audits, meeting notes, and incident logs.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: The current process is manual multi-source report preparation.

EQ1.oracle_value: Manual preparation is slow and risks inconsistent calculations, wording, and weak source traceability.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: Time, consistency, calculation, and traceability problems are explicit.

EQ1.oracle_value: Procurement analyst drafts; procurement manager reviews; category owners and Procurement Quality Team provide or maintain evidence.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: All internal roles and the manager reviewer are identified.

EQ1.oracle_value: Faster, consistent, evidence-grounded reporting with reliable calculations, source references, and manager oversight.
EQ1.accepted_semantics: Value covers efficiency, quality, traceability, and review.

EQ1.oracle_value: Required title and sections, correct one-decimal calculations, exact filenames, supported actions, explicit discrepancy handling, and no unsupported claims.

EQ1_diagnostics.oracle_value: No numerical time-saving, cost-saving, adoption, or accuracy target is specified.
EQ1_diagnostics.accepted_semantics: Any numeric business target is an assumption, not captured fact.

EQ1_diagnostics.oracle_value: No SLA, throughput, latency, source-volume, retention-period, or data-residency target is specified.
Deployment topology, authentication product, exact hosting, and budget may be assumptions but not user-confirmed requirements.
EQ1_diagnostics.accepted_semantics: Implementation defaults are labelled as assumptions.

EQ2.oracle_value: Classify as knowledge synthesis through multi-source report generation.
Select MultiSourceReportGenerator (multi_source_report_generator) as the primary end-to-end module.
Do not add separate executable PDF, spreadsheet, or text parser stages already subsumed by MultiSourceReportGenerator.
Pass the four bundle-resolved files as input_paths; use parser_choice=auto and built-in XLSX/CSV/Markdown normalization.
Configure the six required section specifications and their depends_on relationships from report_spec.json.
Set agentic=true and strict_review=true; use gpt-5.4 writer/reviewer configuration and ASCII-safe progress output.
Set include_source_references=true and include_evidence_index=true; enforce supplied-evidence-only writing and conflict disclosure.
Upload/select inputs, normalize sources, draft and review sections, assemble draft, validate outputs, obtain manager approval or return to analyst rework, then release.
CLI accepts --input bundle, resolves all paths relative to it, writes report.md and evidence_index.json; web UI, external sources, enterprise integration, and DOCX/Pandoc are not required.

EQ3.oracle_value: A non-empty use_case.blueprint.json exists and parses as JSON.
The GAIK Solution Wizard validator returns exit code 0 with no blocking errors.
Workflow inputs and outputs reference declared artifacts with valid producers and dependencies.
A non-empty workflow.mmd covers every blueprint workflow step.
workflow.bpmn parses as XML and maps every blueprint workflow step through IDs, names, or bpmn_mapping.
The PoC contains an entry point, dependency file, configuration, prompts, and schemas.
The package contains non-empty documentation plus PoC usage instructions.
Traceability entries connect requirements to at least one selected GAIK module or building block.

EQ4.oracle_value: The original unmodified generated PoC setup or build command exits with code 0.
The original unmodified PoC processes the supplied four-source bundle and exits with code 0.
The original PoC creates a new non-empty report.md and a non-empty parseable evidence_index.json.
The original report semantically matches expected_report_results.json: required structure, exact metrics, decisions, actions, discrepancy handling, source references, and no unsupported claims.
